system.description:
A tradition adapted from the Depsopteron dragon-kin combat arts — tough, direct, with a draconic aesthetic.

  • Draconic Toughness: While below half HP, your unarmed damage die is one step larger (d4 to d6, d6 to d8, d8 to d10, d10 to d12) — the draconic toughness sharpens under pressure.
  • Scale-Fist Bearing: Advantage on Intimidation checks and on checks to resist fire damage.
